title: Islandia Scene Blueprint
description: Per-spot production brief for a Collection Diorama (visual spec v0.2 §5). Not bundled into the app.

spotId.description: Matches Spot.id and the folder name.

status.description: draft = written from knowledge, NOT yet checked against real references.

spotType.description: Selects the priority order in spec §17.

silhouette.description: What must be readable at 512px with no text.

crop.description: The representative geographic slice (spec §7), not the whole area.

heroScale.description: Perceptual exaggeration of the hero landmark (spec §6).

orientation.description: Which real-world direction faces the camera / where sea, mountains, roads sit.

allowedMiniatureDetails.description: Style-only additions that exist in reality (visitors, boats, trees of the right species).

references.description: File names under reference/ or URLs. Empty until collected.

element.description: The single iconic element kept for the Taiwan World token (spec §9 Asset B).
